rapport_notes: Joanna is friendly, responsive, patient with customer pauses, and uses affirmations ('Mm-hmm', 'Yup') throughout—warm and engaging delivery.
process_discipline_notes: Damage coverage (Sheet 1) and Meet Your Mover (Sheet 2) were answered in Stage 2 after logistics probing had already begun in Stage 1, but neither was raised as a customer concern in Stage 1—this violates the either/or rule (Stage 1 answer if concern raised, OR Stage 2 takeaway if not raised; not a surprise recitation in Stage 2 after probing started).

evidence_quotes.agenda: Do you have any special instructions concerns or stresser about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised beds needing disassembly; Joanna answered 'we can definitely...the service already includes [dis]assembly and reassembly' but did not follow up with 'tell me more' or 'what else concerns you'—stopped at one exchange.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Estimate window: 'Typically that size usually range from four to six hours...for your move the only factor we want to consider is of course the travel in between.' Beats it/pay less: 'we only charge in every fifteen minutes, so we don't charge you for the hour right away.' Self-prep: 'If of course, that's an estimated budget...the shorter it will be the lower the cost at the end of the day.' Missing: 'does that feel fair?' + silence before close, and no 'we commit to the rate' / 100k-move experience framing.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically (addresses, inventory, floor layout, parking, items going to storage) and built a personalized estimate with clear anchoring (4–6 hours typical for 2-bedroom load size, adjusted for traffic), showing strong fact-finding discipline.
coaching_note: Always ask the agenda line before any logistics probing—it must come first—and when a customer raises a concern (like the bed disassembly), dig two layers deep ('Tell me more about that, what else?') before moving on; deliver Sheet 1 and Sheet 2 as Stage 1 answers to concerns only, never as a Stage 2 surprise after probing has started.
